about: P13 obstacle course, one table for the world (gen_obstacles.py -> obstacles.sdf) and the clearance check (scenario.py). Coordinates are PX4 local NED from the spawn point: n north, e east, metres; h is the height above ground. pole: cylinder radius r. box: axis-aligned, size dn (north) x de (east).
drone_radius_note: [D] rotor at (0.1, 0.1) m -> 0.141 m from the centre + 5-inch prop radius 0.064 m (vehicles/research_drone/gen_model.py)
route_note: slalom left/right of the three poles (straight-line clearance to a pole 0.56 m from its surface), through the 1.2 m gate, stop 2.9 m before the end wall
